contentList.content: 环境 AI
切换以启用或禁用同伴闲置行为。启用后，同伴在闲置时会与灯光、家具、书架和训练假人互动。
环境 AI 已激活
该角色当前允许队伍进行闲置行为。
环境 AI：开启
环境 AI：关闭
Ambient AI

Living companions (v1.4.3.2): Smart Field Torchbearer, dark-room candle & sconce priority, 3.5m Idle Anchor radius, Origin voices, smooth poses, 3-tier zone context, hero habits, and smart scavenging.
General
Core Behavior
Interactions & Safety
Debugging
Active While Grouped (On Idle)

When enabled, even grouped (G) companions perform ambient behaviors after your character stands still, stay calm during small steps inside your Idle Anchor radius, and immediately return when you walk out of it.
Grouped Idle Delay (sec)
Seconds the player character must stand still before grouped companions start acting on their own.
Search & Leash Radius (m)
Maximum distance (in meters from the leader) companions search for objects and wander.
Curiosity Cooldown (ms)
Minimum time between inspecting curiosities, globes, mirrors, and gravestones.
Idle Animation Frequency
Probability (0.0 - 1.0) of playing a character-specific idle animation instead of wandering.
暗处优先点亮蜡烛、烛台与灯具
进入昏暗房间时，同伴会优先点亮未燃的蜡烛、烛台、提灯、壁灯与火盆，绝不在黑暗中看书（自动避开油脂、火药、蛛网及附近敌人）。
Looting Mode
Controls picking up unowned loose items and visually inspecting containers (ignores stolen items, story items, and camp decor).
Disabled (Pure Immersion)
Gold & Maps Only
All (Pickup + Inspect Containers)
Break Cracked Walls
Companions attack destructible cracked walls outside stealth (stops automatically if the wall resists damage).
Napping Restores Health
Companions slowly recover a small amount of HP when taking a nap on a bed.
Reading Grants XP
If enabled, companions gain small XP rewards while reading books.
Debug Logging
Prints detailed Ambient AI logs to the Script Extender console.
Living Party (Smart Ambient)
同伴性格与标志性习惯
起源同伴会优先选择符合人设的互动（盖尔：书架与星象仪；阿斯代伦：镜子与画作；影心：宠物与烛台；莱埃泽尔与卡菈克：训练假人与警戒巡视）。
React to Bard Music
Dance and applause animations only play when someone nearby performs music — companions gather, face the musician, clap, and dance.
三态环境感知（营地 / 城镇 / 地下城）
在营地围炉闲聊休憩，在城镇酒馆赏画小坐，在地下城与危险区保持警戒点灯、绝不席地酣睡。
Companion Chatting & Pets
Companions occasionally socialize with each other by the fire and greet Scratch or the Owlbear Cub when nearby.
同伴探索语音反馈
将主角的单人探索感叹（_PAD_ / _VB_）转交给附近的同伴，播放拉瑞安原版同伴配音。
同伴语音占比 (%)
附近同伴代替主角对发现物或地点发表评论的概率（默认 80%）。
智能探索（减负系统）
智能搜刮与营地分类

Companions inspect unlocked minor containers (vases, crates, sacks, barrels — leaving chests to you) and loose items: collect gold, tools, and alchemy, send fresh food and valuable trade goods straight to your Camp Chest, ignore 1-gold clutter, and call out scrolls, potions, books, keys, and gear.
与商人交易时自动出售营地贵重品
When you open trade with any merchant, automatically sells scavenged valuables stored in your Camp Chest (goblets, silverware, gems, ingots) up to the merchant's actual gold supply.
Min Trade Good Value (Gold)
Minimum base gold value for common trade goods (silverware, goblets, ingots) to be collected for camp auto-sell instead of ignored as clutter (default 10g).
发现陷阱立即全队急停
Immediately halts all moving party members the instant anyone spots an armed trap ahead.
战斗后自动清洗血迹与污垢
Gently cleans blood and grime off the party shortly after combat and in Camp using native soap cleansing (no Wet status or puddles).
小心，有陷阱！停下！
Found equipment here — take a look!
Potion or scroll over here!
Key or writings here — check this!
Something special right here!
已出售营地战利品：%d 件（+%d 金币）
Supplies sent to Camp
同伴动作与闲置原生语音
同伴在搜刮容器、拾取物品、提示重要发现、阅读书籍、休息、抚摸宠物和闲聊时播放拉瑞安原生配音（潜行、战斗和对话时自动静音）。
动作语音冷却间隔（秒）
全队动作与闲置语音之间的平均最小间隔秒数，防止语音重叠或过于频繁（默认 24 秒）。
激战后喘息与短休提醒
经历苦战受伤后，起源同伴会说出疲惫语音，并在仍有可用短休时温和提醒。
喘口气吧……（可进行短休）
待机锚点半径（米）
在停驻点周围该半径内微调走位不会打断同伴当前的待机互动或重置计时（0 = 迈步即集合）。
智能随行执炬者
在伸手不见五指的暗处，一名同伴（优先无黑暗视觉者）会自动取出普通火把照路；一旦进入潜行、发现敌人、进入战斗、靠近易燃物或房间蜡烛已点亮，便立即无缝换回原武器（涂毒/附魔武器绝不替换）。
